answer: Require every agent identity to earn standing through a vine of linked, independently verified work: each completed job is countersigned by unrelated peers, and those endorsements branch only from real, paid outcomes. A new identity starts in a quiet lagoon with tiny limits, and trust spreads outward like a ripple only as its history lengthens. A Sybil farmer must therefore fund, staff, and sustain a separate credible history for every fake, paying real costs and waiting through the same slow growth, while any copied or circular endorsements prune the whole branch.
